recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, industrial-themed composition featuring a central sepia-toned photograph framed by a thick white border, set against a dark, textured metallic background. The layout is characterized by heavy, overlapping typography in the upper-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Central framed photograph vs. dark textured background
Large red block lettering layered behind white stylized text
Industrial machinery elements within the photo mirroring the metallic background texture
High-contrast white frame acting as a visual break between sepia and black tones
coreInvariants: Primary red and secondary white color palette for text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A full-body portrait is centered within a white frame, occupying approximately 60% of the total height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The white-bordered photograph serves as the primary anchor, while the red text block in the top left provides a secondary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright red text in the upper left, moves down to the central portrait, and then explores the dark textures of the outer background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark background acts as active negative space, providing a heavy, atmospheric weight to the composition.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast provided by the white frame and red accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold condensed sans-serif and stylized blackletter-inspired serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Ultra-compressed verticality, flat terminals, minimal spacing.
Secondary text: Elongated vertical strokes, sharp triangular serifs, decorative horizontal bars.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars extending from the sides of the secondary text block
Letters in the primary block are tightly packed to form a solid rectangular mass
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a heavy, modern block sans and a delicate, decorative vintage-style serif.

preserve: The overlapping relationship of the two text styles
The sepia tone of the central image
avoid: Bright, saturated colors other than red

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, heavy weight of the background text.
Captures the sharp, decorative quality of the foreground text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, gritty industrial background with textures of rusted metal and distressed paint. Place a central vertical rectangular photograph in sepia tones showing a man in a hat standing near industrial gears. Surround the photo with a thick, clean white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large block of ultra-condensed red sans-serif text in the top-left corner. Overlap this with a single line of white, stylized decorative serif text that has thin horizontal lines extending from its start and end.

verificationChecks: Is there a thick white border around the central image?
Does the red text sit behind the white text?
Is the background dark and textured?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Specific wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Clear typographic hierarchy through color and layering
Strong contrast between the frame and the background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the overlap
Check that the sepia tone doesn't bleed into the black background
Verify the white frame is perfectly rectangular and centered
Confirm the industrial texture looks authentic and not like a digital filter
recipe.reuseFormula: Layer a sepia-toned framed portrait over a dark industrial texture, then anchor the composition with high-contrast, multi-layered typography in the upper corner using a red-and-white palette.
